gen-dafont-visitor-gf-pt-sans-caption: Visitor looks bent from one length of tubing. It handles the loud, retro announcing, while PT Sans Caption, a plain sans with big-bodied lowercase, does the quiet explaining.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-puritan: Puritan sets rounded, side-open forms with oversized e and a counters, friendly and clean on the page. Visitor adds a nostalgic, digital edge, and its pen-like line never tapers, which gives the pair a crisp, steady charm.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-questrial: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor leads with gaping e mouths. Questrial, a plain sans of single-weight strokes with a tall band of letters, keeps a longer passage flowing smoothly.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-radio-canada: Chunky pixel-era charm, then Visitor's short ascenders over big bowls, with Radio Canada's tall, full c, s and z set underneath. The sans carries the line smoothly while the heading supplies the retro spark.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-radio-canada-big: Visitor pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle. Radio Canada Big, a plain sans with a monoline skeleton and terminals clear of the stem, is the quiet counterpart that fills each line.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-readex-pro: Nostalgic Visitor, with its gaping e mouths, sits above Readex Pro, a plain sans with broad terminal gaps. And the two feel like an old arcade screen next to a tidy modern page.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-ruda: Ruda reads wide-mouthed and wire-thin, with a sizable x-height built for screens. And Visitor's nostalgic, solder-drawn heading gives the page a retro jolt before the plain sans settles into an easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-saira: Visitor draws its line at a single width. Saira, a sans-serif with see-through s shapes and rounded letters stretching high, brings the pair a friendly clarity beside that digital, nostalgic heading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-sarpanch: Retro-digital snap comes from Visitor, with short ascenders over big bowls, sitting above Sarpanch's open-mouthed e. The plain sans stays compact and friendly while the heading does the showing off.
